$comment: The import-boundary baseline — issue #2413 / #2414. Every import cycle and every layering inversion the tree has today is listed here with a note saying why it is still allowed. The guard (scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs) fails on a violation that is NOT listed, and on a listed entry that no longer describes a real violation: the baseline only turns down. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs --update` and read the diff — and note that `--update` writes a NEW entry with an empty note, which the check then rejects: `--update` can record that a violation exists, but only a human can say why it is allowed, so fill the note in before the check will pass.
